programs.title: Turner & Hooch
programs.desc: Comedy-thriller starring Tom Hanks. A cop investigates a murder to which there's just one witness: Hooch, a slobbering, beer-drinking French mastiff, who now needs 24/7 protection.

programs.title: Robot Dreams
programs.desc: Pablo Berger's debut animation is the endearing tale of a lonely dog who builds himself a robot friend and a relationship that helps him unlock the joys of 1980s New York City.

programs.title: Notting Hill
programs.desc: Hugh Grant and Julia Roberts star in the BAFTA-winning comedy romance about a bookshop owner who manages to get a glamorous movie star to go out with him. With Rhys Ifans.

programs.title: Groundhog Day
programs.desc: Harold Ramis's classic déjà-vu comedy starring Bill Murray. A TV weatherman must relive the same day reporting on a clairvoyant groundhog until he learns to behave himself.

programs.title: The Pope's Exorcist
programs.desc: Supernatural horror starring Russell Crowe, loosely based on the memoirs of a 'real' exorcist. A case of demonic possession in Spain connects to dark secrets from the Inquisition.

programs.title: Stage Mother
programs.desc: Feel-good comedy-drama with Jacki Weaver. Two worlds collide when a small-town, conservative choir director inherits a drag club in San Francisco from her estranged son.
